ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: To pass through the layered barrier is to get beyond an obstruction described as doubled, repeated, or especially difficult.
EvidenceBody: Commentators praise a woman as armored head to foot and passing straight through the layered barrier. Other records define the phrase beside great death and renewed life or describe an arrow shooting through it.
Hall speakers also warn that without pressing through this barrier there remains no road of emergence, making passage an openly tested threshold rather than a decorative victory title.

DraftEvidence.ZenBend: Barrier language is intensified into a layered obstruction whose passage is judged in cases, memorials, and public addresses.
DraftEvidence.CounterexampleOrLimit: The sources do not provide one numbered map of the layers; the entry preserves the recurrent passage predicate without inventing stages.

ComparedThings: to pass through the layered barrier
its attested grammatical and rhetorical deployments
DifferentThingTest.Reason: Pass, shoot through, and fail to penetrate all govern the same intensified barrier image.

DraftEvidence.AliasRationale: Pass, penetrate, layered, heavy, successive, and barrier expose both verb and obstruction.

ModifierControls.Finding: Repeated obstruction, shooting-through, and absence of an exit establish a strengthened barrier directly.

FamilyControls.Finding: The eye claimed capable of seeing through a barrier, not the passage action itself.
